newsitem.title: CANADA: G.T.C. Transcontinental renews issuer bid.
newsitem.headline: G.T.C. Transcontinental renews issuer bid.

text.p: G.T.C. Transcontinental Group Ltd said it has been authorized to renew its normal course issuer bid.
Under the plan, the company could buy up back to 843,448 of its Class B shares, or five percent of its 16,868,972 Class B outstanding, between December 3, 1996 and December 2, 1997.

The company also has been authorized to buy back over the same period up to 1,788,826 of its Class A subordinate voting shares, representing 10 percent of the public float of its 18,068,110 issued and outstanding Class A shares.
During the period from December 3, 1995 to December 2, 1996, G.T.C Transcontinental did not buy back any of its oustanding Class B and Class A subordinate voting shares, the company said.
